onboardingTitle.message: Welcome! Before you start, choose how you want to bypass the Netflix household restriction.

cssBlockDesc.message: Hides and removes Netflix's restriction modal directly in your browser using CSS and DOM manipulation. The network request still completes normally — we simply make the modal invisible.

legalSafeText.message: Only modifies what is displayed, not what is sent over the network. The Netflix page works fully; we just hide the block screen. This is the safest approach legally.

apiBlockDesc.message: Completely blocks the GraphQL endpoint web.prod.cloud.netflix.com/graphql at the network level. The restriction check never reaches Netflix's servers.

legalWarnText.message: Intercepts and drops the network request entirely using the browser's declarativeNetRequest API. The restriction modal never loads.
